channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: French island offers up to €10,000 to second-home owners who rent out their property
item.description: Local officials on a French island are offering incentives of up to €10,000 to second-home owners who are willing to rent out their properties on a long-term lease, in order to try and overcome the housing shortage for locals.

item.title: Brits now fifth largest immigrant group in France
item.description: New data from the French government shows that British nationals now make up the fifth largest group of foreign residency-permit holders in France.

item.title: Four international night trains from Germany to try in 2026
item.description: Several new night trains will bring passengers from Germany to popular cities around Europe this year, and a couple of popular connections that were set to end are being saved. Here are four exciting overnight journeys to ride this year.

item.title: French hospital treats man with WWI shell up his rectum
item.description: Bomb disposal experts had to be called to a hospital in south-west France on Sunday after a patient arrived with a WWI shell lodged in his rectum.

item.title: French actor sells used tissue for €100,000
item.description: A used tissue put up for auction by the French actor Pierre Niney has attracted bids rising to €100,000, which the actor says will be donated to charity.

item.title: Is Paris really going to ban second homes?
item.description: The city of Paris has been introducing more stringent measures against second homes, in an attempt to ease the capital's housing shortage, but will it really go as far as banning them altogether?

item.title: EU says countries can halt EES checks over summer to avoid travel chaos
item.description: Member States will have the green light to partially suspend Europe's Entry/Exit System (EES), the new EU digital border system, over the summer to avoid any travel chaos at ports and airports during peak season.

item.title: OPINION: TV anchor's child sex conviction reveals hypocrisy of French right-wingers
item.description: Hypocrisy knows no political boundaries - writes John Lichfield - it can occur on the Left, on the Right and in the Centre. France is currently witnessing a particularly extreme and puzzling case of hypocrisy on the moralising, hard Right.

item.title: What jurisdiction do French courts have over people outside France?
item.description: It's not uncommon for French prosecutors to launch investigations into people or businesses - but what jurisdiction do French courts have over those outside France?

item.title: France summons Musk for questioning as X deepfake backlash grows
item.description: French cybercrime authorities carried out a search of the French offices of X (formerly Twitter) on Tuesday whilst the Paris public prosecutor's office also announced they have issued a summons to owner Elon Musk.
